description: This file contains utility functions for reading a file into memory and printing file contents and data buffers, primarily used in unit testing contexts. It includes function definitions for reading a file into memory and printing its contents along with some test-specific structures.

methods.name: int read_file_into_memory(const char * filename,test_ut_memory_t * pInstance)
methods.description: Reads the specified file into a memory buffer within a provided test utility memory structure, handling errors related to file access, seeking, and memory allocation.

methods.name: void print_input_output(char * kvpData,const char * filename)
methods.description: Prints the contents of a file (if successfully read) and a data buffer to standard output, mainly for debugging and test observation.
